Title: By the Seashore

"""

matches = re.findall(pattern, data, re.DOTALL)

paintings = []

    width = float(width)

for p in paintings:

largest = max(paintings, key=lambda x: x['area_cm2'])
print("\nPainting with the largest area:")

}

Comparing the two, **Garden at Sainte-Adresse** by Claude Monet has the larger area.

The year in which the painting with the largest area was created is **1867**.
